title: From CPAC to NatCon to BACPAC : Trumpism Down Under
content:

You can read more about the gathering — which starred Angus ‘Fantastic’ Taylor (Liberal), semi-pro cosplayer Matt Canavan (National) and of course Pauline ‘I Don’t Like It!’ Hanson (PHONy) — in accounts by:

title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #300 w Emma Hagberg on ‘Comrades, Not Friends’ & The Revolutionary Front : October 8, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to Emma Hagberg. Emma is the author of Comrades, Not Friends: The Revolutionary Front, Antifascism, and Class Struggle (PM Press/Working Class History, 2026), translated by Gabriel Kuhn and with a preface by Tomas Rothaus (both of whom have been previous guests of the show).

According to Hagberg, RF had ‘a strong collective identity, the view of fascists as class traitors, and the critique of an autonomous left that often had no place for working-class people’; Comrades was originally published in Swedish as 18.6 – Kamrater, Inte Vänner (B.E.L Publishing, 2024) and is also available in a German translation.

The Revolutionary Front (RF), 2001–2015, was the most militant organization on the left in recent Swedish history. Staunchly working class, the first generation of RF members engaged in numerous street battles with Swedish fascists. When the fascists retreated from the streets, RF attacked them in their homes. The police cracked down on the organization in 2013, raiding the apartments of several alleged members at the crack of dawn. The courts handed out prison sentences of up to six and a half years. Two years later, the organization folded.

See also : Presentation on the book about Revolutionära Fronten (Revolutionary Front) (April 13, 2025).

4.30pm, October 8, 2026 /// 855AM, digital, streaming, Community Radio Plus, podcats.

title: Yeah Nah Pasaran #299 w Leena van Deventer on GamerGate & the grievance economy : October 1, 2026
content:
This week on Yeah Nah Pasaran! we talk to Leena van Deventer [Bluesky]. Leena is a game developer, writer and researcher. Among her current interests is the concept of:

Hetconning (n.) — the deliberate retroactive straight-washing of history. Hetconned, the project, maps how the contemporary far-right market different post-truth fantasies to recruit and radicalise people into fighting for the Christo-nationalist project.
